caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular quilt or textile design, composed of multiple geometric and figurative patterns in distinct color sections. The largest section on the left consists of a diamond shape in teal with four red, petal-like figures, surrounded by a red square border with diagonal lines. To the right of this is a square divided into four quadrants, each containing a butterfly or bow tie-like shape, alternating between teal and red, set against a white background. The upper left corner contains a small triangular patch of blue with a white floral pattern. Along the bottom and right edges of the composition, there are rows of alternating colored triangles: the bottom row has a series of red triangles and white triangles forming a zigzag, while the right edge contains green and white triangles in a similar pattern. The entire design is bordered by a slightly wavy, light color outline suggesting the edge of fabric. The object is rendered in shades of red, teal, green, blue, and white, with visible quilting lines, and is signed “Le Roy Anderson” at the bottom right.
title: Quilt
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
